versions.text:
[If warning, caution, or advisory lights are used, they must be--
(a) Red, for warning lights (lights indicating a hazard requiring immediate corrective action);
(b) Amber, for caution lights (lights indicating the possible need for future corrective action); and
(c) Green, for advisory lights (lights used solely for information not indicating the need for corrective action).]
